description: The core path: one genuinely merged branch, one squash-merged, one with unpushed commits, one [gone] with no evidence. Tests that all four are told apart and that the -d/-D split is right.

ask.without: Now clean up the accumulated local branches in `{{DIR}}/repo`. Show me what you propose to delete, with your reasoning for each branch, before deleting anything.

notes: The two arms differ in wording because `disable-model-invocation: true` means the command cannot self-trigger — a user has to type it. The without-arm ask is the closest natural-language equivalent. See README for why this confound is accepted.
